decisions.proposed_text: Chỉ gồm Mã Nương huấn luyện ★3 kỷ niệm DAY1!

decisions.terminology_basis: Manual-audit policy requires generic 赛马娘/ウマ娘 → Mã Nương; preserve DAY1 and ★3.

decisions.proposed_text: Chỉ gồm Mã Nương huấn luyện ★3 kỷ niệm phim điện ảnh 『Mã Nương』!
decisions.reason: Both generic 育成赛马娘 and the quoted short 赛马娘 label are not the full franchise title; the manual audit rule therefore uses Mã Nương instead of bare Uma Musume.
decisions.terminology_basis: Manual-audit policy requires generic 赛马娘/ウマ娘 → Mã Nương and preserves Umamusume: Pretty Derby only when the full franchise title is present.

decisions.proposed_text: Chỉ gồm Support Card SSR kỷ niệm phim điện ảnh 『Mã Nương』!
decisions.reason: Support Card is already canonical, but the quoted short 赛马娘 label is generic/short-form rather than the full franchise title and must use Mã Nương.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.support_card requires Support Card; embedded common.world.umamusume/manual audit policy require generic 赛马娘 → Mã Nương.
